How do I return an item? If you’re not completely satisfied, most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery or purchase . How to Return In-store Returns Items purchased in store must be returned to a Macy’s store Returns are always free Online Returns Items purchased online can be returned in-store or by mail* Return in-store: Always free Return by mail: Free for Star Rewards members. Non-members pay a $9.99 return shipping fee (plus tax), which will be deducted from the refund. * Macy's is not responsible for merchandise purchased from other retailers that is mistakenly sent to our return facilities. We cannot guarantee the identification, recovery, or return of such merchandise. Refunds Refunds are issued to your original form of payment Some items (like jewelry and watches) require an inspection before refund is processed Return Requirements What condition must items be in to be returned? Unworn and unaltered In original condition With original tags attached In original packaging (when applicable) Additional notes: Mismatched garment sets are not accepted Cosmetics and fragrances may be returned if they don’t meet your needs Return Fees In-store returns In-store returns are always free. Mail returns Free for Star Rewards members $9.99 fee for non-members (plus tax) Some items may include restocking fees or nonrefundable delivery charges (see Exceptions) Free return exclusions Free return shipping does not apply to: Lamps Wall art and mirrors Furniture and furniture accessories Beds Area rugs Gifts & Registry Returns Returning
